text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Biko Pegasus—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-The light is green...
Please cross the street~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Rice-senpai! Whatcha doing?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Biko-san...
I'm volunteering for traffic safety duty.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Rice-senpai is a hero protecting safety too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not a hero or anything... Rice just wanted
everyone to be able to stay safe.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That spirit right there is already that of a hero!
Hey, hey! Can I help you out, Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, the light has turned green!
Please look both ways before crossing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah... Biko-san. You really seem used to this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I used to watch it all the time as a kid!
My pops is a police officer, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero who protects the peace of the town!
That's why I respect my dad so much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I see...! I wonder if Biko's strong sense of justice
comes from her father...?"

Just then, some elementary school Umamusume came running over.
They were straying outside the Umamusume-only lane, so they needed a warning.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry~~!
The carrot soft serve is gonna sell out~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: If you're going to run full out, you need to use the dedicated lane.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? I wasn't running that seriously anyway!
Isn't that just barely on the limit?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But... isn't it dangerous if we don't follow the rules...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Other girls do this much too, right?
Besides, I'm confident I won't crash!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, well............ Fueee...
How can I say it so you'll understand...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Rice-senpai, don't overthink it!
What matters most is *why* you want them to follow the rules!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys! Sure is nice out today!
Are you heading out to hang out after this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... yeah.
I promised to eat ice cream with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be looking forward to that!
I totally get that exciting feeling!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Still, an Umamusume crashing at full speed is dangerous! That's why dedicated lanes exist to prevent it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to enjoy eating ice cream!
I want them to spend their days smiling!
That's why I don't want anyone getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You know, Rice doesn't want to make everyone look sad either...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'll be careful from now on.
Um... thank you!

The Umamusume nodded to each other
and dashed down their dedicated lanes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today, Biko-san...
Thanks to you, those kids...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: My dad used to say that when someone breaks the rules, they've got their own reasons behind it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"So, if you want someone to listen to you,
you have to start by understanding them."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Words from someone who truly understands you
resonate so much deeper in your heart!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right...!
I ended up learning something really important.
choice_data_list: What your father taught you is wonderful!
What your father taught you is wonderful!
You're amazing for putting that into practice, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right...!
I ended up learning something really important.
choice_data_list: What your father taught you is wonderful!
What your father taught you is wonderful!
You're amazing for putting that into practice, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Dad is
just as much my hero
as Carrotman is!!

Biko Pegasus looked exceedingly proud
as he said that.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is nothing! It's only natural for a hero!
...Ehehehe♪
Biko Pegasus laughed bashfully.
